I wrote `component.html` in the folder: a 1280px Approvals screen inside `#component`, static HTML and CSS only. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Content:** The heading, the "3 waiting for you" line, and the three items match your text. Each item has an Approve button and a Decline button.
- **Layout:** Each item is one dense card row with the title, requester, right-aligned amount and the two buttons in separate columns. The 64px page margins, 4px-based spacing, pill buttons at least 44px tall and 16px card radius come from `DESIGN.md`.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo can't be loaded because there are no other assets. The CSS names them first and falls back to system fonts, so it will look different on a machine without them installed.
- **Not in the spec:** I gave the Decline button a thin accent-line border so it still reads as a button. I also gave the Approve button an accent hover. Both use only palette colors.
- **Accessibility:** The buttons have aria-labels that name their item, such as "Approve Q4 travel budget".
- **Unused files:** `session.json` was empty and `session.err` only held a model-name warning.
